content:
**1 Star – Worst Mattress Ever!**

This foam mattress was a complete waste of money—it sagged within weeks, leaving me with terrible back pain. The material feels cheap and flimsy, nothing like the "premium comfort" advertised. It sleeps hot, making me sweat through the night no matter how cool my room is. The off-gassing smell lingered for days, giving me headaches. Even worse, the edges collapse when I sit on them, making it impossible to get out of bed comfortably. Customer service was unhelpful when I tried to return it, offering only a partial refund. For the price, I expected so much more—this mattress is a total scam. Save yourself the frustration and look elsewhere.
